name: 14068 · Getzville, NY
findings: ZIP 14068 (Getzville) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14068 (Getzville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14068 (Getzville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).
